retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s studio portrait featuring a smiling male subject in a plaid shirt with right-aligned, high-contrast serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close studio portrait of a smiling man wearing a blue and white plaid flannel shirt, positioned on the left, looking toward the right. The background is a soft, solid blue-to-grey gradient. The right side of the frame is occupied by vertically stacked, right-aligned serif typography in alternating colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the typographic block
Plaid pattern texture contrasting with smooth background
Right-aligned text balancing the left-weighted subject
Color harmony between the shirt's blue and the background
coreInvariants: Blue and white plaid flannel shirt
Soft studio lighting with gentle shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze to the text on the right, then moves down the typographic stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides a clean area for the primary title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blue and grey (background and shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Mid-range saturation with high value contrast in the typography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blues, purples, and neutrals

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Condensed width for the main title lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same serif family to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and vertical stress of the display text.
Provides the classic mid-century editorial feel for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a smiling man in his 40s with dark hair, wearing a blue and white plaid flannel shirt, positioned on the left side of the frame against a soft blue-grey gradient background. Leave the right third of the frame empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned, uppercase serif text in the upper right quadrant. Use a deep purple for the top two lines and white for the subsequent lines. Ensure tight leading and high stroke contrast.

verificationChecks: Is the subject wearing a blue plaid shirt?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?
Is the background a soft blue gradient?

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Verify text does not overlap the subject's face
Check that the serif font has high stroke contrast
Ensure the plaid pattern is clearly defined
Confirm right-justification of all text blocks
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Plaid Flannel + Right-Aligned High-Contrast Serif Typography + Muted Blue Palette
